subject: Latent-shift status: replication done, incident study needs proxy quality
body:
Hi Dmitri, Santiago,

Status. Replication closed Apr 22 — Quentin reproduced the synthetic-data results from the released notebooks: the discrete eigendecomposition numbers match Table 1, and the 10-seed model comparison matches Table 2 within seed noise. His shift-strength sweeps also reproduce the figures for both the WAE method and the continuous spectral method, so we trust the codebase end to end.

Incident study (the interesting part): on the historical incident, the method recovers the latent subgroup structure and — had it been running — would have flagged the prevalence shift 9 days before our on-call did. That's the headline for Jun 24.

The caveat: it only works when the proxy variables actually carry subgroup signal. Freya ran an ablation degrading proxy quality; below a measurable threshold the recovered subgroups go to mush, silently. So the productionization story must include a proxy-strength diagnostic as a gate — otherwise we'd be shipping false confidence, which is worse than the status quo.

Kaia
